item.title: Cone Zone Alert Issued for Road Work in Cathedral City
item.description: Cathedral City’s Public Works Department is issuing a cone zone alert for commuters and residents ahead of scheduled road work tomorrow morning.Crews will be grinding asphalt bumps at the intersection of Cathedral Canyon Drive and Donna Shore Drive beginning at 7 a.m. and continuing through 1 p.m.During the work, one lane will be closed at a time while traffic flow is maintained in all directions. item.title: New Art Exhibit Honors Influential Women in the Coachella Valley
item.description: The Coachella Valley is known for celebrating creativity, and a new art exhibit is now shining a spotlight on the influential women who help shape the community.The exhibit, titled “Portraits of Her,” is on display at Cicada Fine Arts Studio in Palm Springs. item.title: Palm Springs Hit-and-Run Death Sparks Community Grief and Renewed Push for Pedestrian Safety
item.description: A deadly hit-and-run crash in Palm Springs has left a community mourning the loss of a familiar face—and calling for greater attention to pedestrian safety.Fifty-six-year-old Ricardo Marano was killed earlier this month after being struck by a vehicle in a hit-and-run collision. item.title: Roggin Report: New Study Finds We Love Giving Honest Feedback — But Hate Receiving It
item.description: On this week’s Roggin Report, Fred Roggin tackled a topic most of us can relate to: honesty — and why we’re far better at giving it than receiving it.Roggin highlighted a new scientific study showing a clear double standard in how people handle feedback. When we deliver blunt or “brutally honest” opinions, we tend to see ourselves as helpful or courageous.
